messages:
Maya S: FYI inbound SIG from NimbleHealth via Zendesk. They flagged BYOK + attestation and want a short POC to validate key custody flow. Ticket: https://zendesk.example/ticket/SEC-2026-889. Need security owner.
security-bot: New ticket SEC-2026-889 queued to security-intake (unassigned).
Devon P: Assign to me please. Quick ask: do they want true customer-managed HSM (on-prem/cloud-HSM) or just CMEK? The questionnaire Q7 is vague.
Maya S: Sales notes say they'd prefer customer HSM, but open to a cloud-KMS option if we can demonstrate separation of duties. Asking for timeline of POC and sample traffic.
Ravi K: I can run the POC infra for encryption path. Will need masked sample schema and expected token rates. Also need to confirm whether logs can be shared or must be redacted.
Lena T: If they require HSM attestation (FIPS or Common Criteria), we'll need to check partner attestation docs. I can pull our Thales/PartnerX integration artifacts.
Devon P: Action list: Lena -> gather attestation certs and sample wording; Ravi -> outline POC infra and temporary test keys; Maya -> ask customer for masked sample + network diagram + NDA. I'll start drafting SIG responses for the BYOK sections.
Maya S: Customer estimate: peak 60 rps, steady 15 rps. They'll only provide masked data; NDA might be required for any logs. I'll ping them today for materials.
Ravi K: For the POC we can spin up a private tenant instance with CMEK and simulate CloudHSM flow. If they insist on on-prem HSM, that'll push timeline and require architecture review.
Lena T: Added presales note to ticket about supported key flows and attestation: AWS CloudHSM, GCP CMEK, Partner HSM attestation options.
Devon P: Marking ticket P1-enterprise. Devon assigned. I'll add checklist items to the Zendesk ticket and link the SIG draft.
security-bot: Reminder: attach NDA status and any network diagram before closing design step.
Maya S: Thanks all. Tentative sync Tue 10:00 PT. I'll forward any customer uploads to the ticket.
Devon P: Sounds good. I'll post the SIG draft snippets in the ticket once I have Lena's attestation language.
Ravi K: I'll prepare a short runbook for the POC steps and infra costs estimate.
Maya S: :thumbsup:
